title: BURGER: Benchmarking and Understanding Robotic Generalization via Embodied Drawing
title_zh: BURGER：通过具身绘图进行机器人泛化能力的基准测试与理解

paragraphs.en: How effectively can vision-language-action (VLA) models learn diverse language-conditioned behaviors as training data scales? Investigating this question requires large and varied robot datasets, whose collection on physical robots remains costly. We introduce BURGER, a language-conditioned robotic drawing benchmark with a scalable, prompt-driven pipeline for generating continuous drawing trajectories, both in simulation and the real world. In BURGER, an agent starts from the same blank canvas and controls a robot arm to draw the object or spatial composition specified by language, while each instruction allows an open-ended variety of valid drawings and stroke orders. Using 28,200 simulated demonstrations spanning 282 drawing tasks, we evaluate five representative VLA models across data scales, language grounding, and multimodal behavior. BURGER supports fine-grained analysis of language grounding, spatial composition, and action generation, revealing distinct failure patterns across VLA models. Our experiments suggest that some VLA models can benefit from greater task diversity and demonstration scale, capture multimodal drawing behaviors, and generalize to unseen compositions of familiar objects. Finally, we deploy a trained policy on a Franka Panda arm, demonstrating the ability to draw reactively under human intervention. Project homepage and code can be found here .
paragraphs.zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在训练数据规模扩大时，能多有效地学习多样化的语言条件行为？ 研究这一问题需要大规模且多样的机器人数据集，而在物理机器人上采集此类数据集的成本依然高昂。 我们提出 BURGER，这是一个语言条件机器人绘图基准，配备可扩展的、由提示驱动的流水线，用于在仿真和真实世界中生成连续的绘图轨迹。 在 BURGER 中，一个智能体从同一张空白画布开始，控制机械臂绘制由语言指定的物体或空间构图，而每条指令都允许存在开放多样的有效绘图和笔画顺序。 利用涵盖 282 个绘图任务的 28,200 条仿真演示数据，我们在数据规模、语言基础和多模态行为方面评估了五个具有代表性的 VLA 模型。 BURGER 支持对语言基础、空间构图和动作生成进行细粒度分析，揭示了不同 VLA 模型各自独特的失败模式。 我们的实验表明，一些 VLA 模型能够从更大的任务多样性和演示规模中受益，捕捉多模态绘图行为，并泛化到熟悉物体的未见构图。 最后，我们将训练好的策略部署在 Franka Panda 机械臂上，展示了在人为干预下进行反应式绘图的能力。 项目主页和代码可在此处找到。

paragraphs.en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models integrate visual perception, language understanding, and action generation into policies for robotic control [ 40 , 14 , 4 , 3 ] . As VLA models increasingly benefit from larger and more diverse datasets, an important question is whether current architectures are ready to effectively exploit large-scale language-conditioned robot trajectories. Investigating this question requires robot datasets with controllable scale and diversity, together with evaluations that distinguish different aspects of model behavior [ 21 , 39 , 35 ] . However, collecting diverse demonstrations on physical robots remains costly [ 12 , 23 ] , which motivates a more scalable setting for such studies.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型将视觉感知、语言理解和动作生成整合到用于机器人控制的策略中 [40, 14, 4, 3]。 随着 VLA 模型越来越多地受益于更大、更多样化的数据集，一个重要的问题是：当前的架构是否已经准备好有效地利用大规模的语言条件化机器人轨迹数据。 研究这个问题需要具有可控规模和多样性的机器人数据集，并辅以能够区分模型行为不同方面的评估方法 [21, 39, 35]。 然而，在物理机器人上收集多样化的演示数据仍然成本高昂 [12, 23]，这促使我们需要一个更具可扩展性的研究环境。

paragraphs.en: Robotic drawing provides a complementary data regime with several practical advantages for such studies. Starting from the same blank canvas, the agent cannot infer the requested drawing from the initial observation alone, eliminating a potential visual shortcut [ 37 ] . Language prompts can be systematically increased in semantic complexity by composing objects, attributes, and spatial relations. The same instruction can admit many valid trajectories that differ in stroke order, starting point, and drawing direction, this intrinsic multimodality forces model to understand the concept, rather than memorizing the action sequence. The resulting canvases and execution trajectories make semantic, spatial, and action-execution failures directly inspectable, supporting fine-grained diagnosis of model behavior. Drawing therefore provides a scalable setting for testing whether VLA architectures can learn complex language-conditioned and multimodal robot trajectories before scaling up costly real-world data collection.
paragraphs.zh: 机器人绘画为此类研究提供了一种具有若干实用优势的互补数据模式。 从同一张空白画布出发，智能体无法仅凭初始观察推断出要求绘制的图形，从而消除了潜在的视觉捷径 [ 37 ] 。 通过组合物体、属性和空间关系，语言提示的语义复杂度可以被系统地提升。 同一条指令可以对应多条在笔画顺序、起点和绘制方向上各不相同的有效轨迹，这种内在的多模态性迫使模型理解概念，而不是记忆动作序列。 由此产生的画布和执行轨迹使语义、空间和动作执行方面的失败可以直接被检查，从而支持对模型行为的细粒度诊断。 因此，绘画提供了一个可扩展的测试环境，用于检验 VLA 架构在扩大昂贵的真实世界数据采集之前，能否学习复杂的语言条件化和多模态机器人轨迹。

paragraphs.en: Motivated by these properties, we introduce BURGER, a scalable benchmark and data-generation pipeline for language-conditioned robotic drawing, shown in Fig. 1 . Our pipeline generates target sketches from natural-language prompts and converts them into robot end-effector trajectories executable in simulation and on a real robot. Using this pipeline, we construct 132 single-object tasks and 150 compositional tasks, with 100 demonstrations per task. The dataset spans diverse objects, spatial compositions, and trajectory realizations. As illustrated in Fig. 2 , drawing trajectories in BURGER exhibit substantially greater diversity in the plane for a given instruction than manipulation trajectories in LIBERO [ 18 ] . We introduce a DINOv3-based metric for scalable evaluation of generated drawings and validate its agreement with human judgments in a single-object user study.

paragraphs.en: We use BURGER to examine how representative VLA models learn from larger datasets, capture trajectory diversity, and generalize to new compositions. The flow-matching models generally improve as either the number of demonstrations per task or the number of training tasks increases, suggesting that some existing approaches can benefit from scaling robotic drawing data. The π \pi -family models [ 4 , 3 ] can autonomously produce recognizable drawings after fine-tuning. Beyond visual recognizability, π 0 \pi_{0} retains multiple modes of the drawing trajectory distribution, as shown in Fig. 2 . We further observe that evaluated policies can generate unseen spatial compositions of familiar objects, but struggle to draw object categories absent from training. Inspecting the resulting drawings and trajectories reveals semantic, spatial, and geometric failure patterns that are difficult to distinguish through task-success metrics alone. We further demonstrate successful real-robot drawing after fine-tuning on 100 real-robot demonstrations alone, as well as sim-to-real transfer of a policy co-trained on 13,200 simulated BURGER demonstrations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 BURGER 来考察具有代表性的 VLA 模型如何从更大的数据集中学习、捕捉轨迹多样性，并泛化到新的组合。 随着每个任务示范数量或训练任务数量的增加，流匹配模型总体上有所提升，这表明一些现有方法可以从扩展机器人绘图数据中受益。 π \pi 系列模型 [4, 3] 在微调后能够自主生成可识别的图画。 除视觉可识别性之外，π 0 \pi_{0} 还保留了绘图轨迹分布的多种模式，如图 2 所示。 我们进一步观察到，被评估的策略能够生成熟悉物体的未见空间组合，但难以绘制训练中缺失的物体类别。 对生成的图画和轨迹的检查揭示了语义、空间和几何层面的失败模式，这些模式仅通过任务成功率指标难以区分。 我们进一步展示了仅基于 100 条真实机器人示范微调后成功进行真实机器人绘图，以及在 13,200 条模拟 BURGER 示范上协同训练的策略的模拟到现实迁移。

These capabilities are also central to language-conditioned manipulation, making BURGER a distinctive lens for examining the readiness and limitations of current VLA architectures in learning from larger and more diverse training datasets.

paragraphs.en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models map visual observations and language instructions to robot actions. Recent VLAs broadly follow autoregressive or continuous generative paradigms. Autoregressive models, such as OpenVLA [ 14 ] , predict actions sequentially, with recent variants improving action representations, chunking, and parallel decoding [ 13 , 24 , 29 , 32 , 20 ] . Continuous generative models produce action chunks using flow matching or diffusion [ 17 ] : π 0 \pi_{0} and π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} use flow matching [ 4 , 3 ] , while RDT-1B and GR00T N1 adopt diffusion-based generation [ 19 , 2 ] . Hybrid methods such as DiffusionVLA [ 36 ] combine autoregressive reasoning with diffusion-based action generation. BURGER evaluates these paradigms under multimodal, long-horizon, and semantically rich drawing data.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型将视觉观测和语言指令映射为机器人动作。 近期的 VLA 大致遵循自回归或连续生成两类范式。 自回归模型，如 OpenVLA [ 14 ] ，按顺序预测动作，近期的变体在动作表示、分块和并行解码方面有所改进 [ 13 , 24 , 29 , 32 , 20 ] 。 连续生成模型使用流匹配或扩散来生成动作块 [ 17 ] ：π 0 \pi_{0} 和 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 使用流匹配 [ 4 , 3 ] ，而 RDT-1B 和 GR00T N1 采用基于扩散的生成 [ 19 , 2 ] 。 诸如 DiffusionVLA [ 36 ] 之类的混合方法将自回归推理与基于扩散的动作生成相结合。 BURGER 在多模态、长时程且语义丰富的绘图数据下评估这些范式。

sents.en: BURGER evaluates these paradigms under multimodal, long-horizon, and semantically rich drawing data.

paragraphs.en: Benchmarking of VLA systems has moved beyond measuring binary task success rates toward more diagnostic evaluation. Recent benchmarks evaluate VLA abilities in long-horizon reasoning, spatial and semantic grounding, robustness to scene or language perturbations, structured behavioral metrics, and memory-dependent manipulation [ 39 , 35 , 33 , 7 , 6 ] . These efforts show that similar success rates can hide different failure modes in grounding, planning, robustness, or temporal consistency. BURGER follows this capability-oriented evaluation direction, but uses language-conditioned drawing as the diagnostic domain. Unlike goal-oriented manipulation, drawing admits many valid stroke orders, geometries, and trajectories for the same prompt. This makes the more dedicated abilities directly observable from the generated canvas and rollout trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: VLA系统的基准测试已从测量二元的任务成功率转向更具诊断性的评估。 近期的基准测试评估VLA在长程推理、空间与语义定位、对场景或语言扰动的鲁棒性、结构化行为指标以及依赖记忆的操作等方面的能力 [ 39 , 35 , 33 , 7 , 6 ] 。 这些工作表明，相近的成功率可能掩盖了在定位、规划、鲁棒性或时间一致性上不同的失败模式。 BURGER沿袭了这一面向能力的评估方向，但将语言条件下的绘画作为诊断领域。 与面向目标的操作不同，对于同一个提示，绘画允许存在多种有效的笔画顺序、几何形状和轨迹。 这使得那些更专门的能力可以直接从生成的画布和 rollout 轨迹中观察到。

paragraphs.en: Robotic drawing and painting have been studied primarily as a control and planning problem. For example, Lee et al. [ 15 ] formulate robotic sketching as a deep decoupled hierarchical reinforcement learning problem, where separate policies learn stroke-based rendering and motor control from scratch. FRIDA [ 27 ] develops a collaborative robot painting system with a differentiable real2sim2real planning environment, enabling a robot to generate paintings from high-level human inputs such as language descriptions or reference images. More recently, IMPASTO [ 34 ] studies robotic oil-painting reproduction by integrating learned pixel dynamics models with model-based planning. These works advance robotic drawing by improving stroke planning, motor control, and real-world execution. In contrast, our work studies sketching as a language-conditioned VLA benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: 机器人绘画与绘图主要被作为一种控制与规划问题来研究。例如，Lee 等人 [ 15 ] 将机器人素描构建为一个深度解耦的分层强化学习问题，其中由独立的策略从零开始学习基于笔画的渲染与运动控制。 FRIDA [ 27 ] 开发了一个协作式机器人绘画系统，该系统具备可微分的 real2sim2real 规划环境，使机器人能够根据语言描述或参考图像等高层人类输入生成画作。 最近，IMPASTO [ 34 ] 通过将学习到的像素动力学模型与基于模型的规划相结合，研究机器人油画复现。 这些工作通过改进笔画规划、运动控制和真实世界执行来推进机器人绘图领域的发展。 与之相反，我们的工作将素描作为一种语言条件下的 VLA 基准来研究。

paragraphs.en: At time t t , a policy receives a language instruction ℓ \ell , a canvas observation I t I_{t} , and robot proprioception q t q_{t} , and predicts an end-effector command a t a_{t} (or an action chunk, depending on the model). The task is to produce the requested object or spatial composition through sequential drawing actions. The policy is not given a target sketch at inference. Canvas observations change as strokes accumulate, while pen-lifting transitions separate disconnected strokes. The benchmark therefore involves both drawing geometry and decisions about when to move without marking the canvas.
paragraphs.zh: 在时刻 t，策略接收语言指令 ℓ、画布观测 I_t 以及机器人本体感知 q_t，并预测末端执行器命令 a_t（或动作块，取决于模型）。 任务是通过顺序的绘制动作生成所要求的物体或空间组合。 推理时不会给策略提供目标草图。 随着笔画的累积，画布观测会发生变化，而抬笔的过渡动作将不相连的笔画分隔开。 因此，该基准测试既涉及绘制几何图形，也涉及何时在不接触画布的情况下移动的决策。

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 summarizes our prompt-to-trajectory pipeline. Diffusion-based image generation models have shown strong capabilities in producing diverse visual content from text prompts [ 38 ] . We use GPT-Image 2 [ 22 ] to generate sketch candidates and convert them into ordered SVG strokes; Appendix A.2 describes the image-processing, skeletonization, and stroke-ordering steps. We replay each SVG in ManiSkill [ 30 ] using an end-effector pose controller, lifting the pen between disconnected strokes. We record RGB observations, robot proprioception, and actions as observation-action pairs, then convert the trajectories to the robot-dataset format. Although our main experiments use ManiSkill with the SAPIEN backend, we also implement the pipeline in MuJoCo and Isaac Sim, as shown in Figure 4 .
paragraphs.zh: 图 1 总结了我们的提示到轨迹流程。 基于扩散的图像生成模型已展现出从文本提示生成多样视觉内容的强大能力 [ 38 ] 。 我们使用 GPT-Image 2 [ 22 ] 生成草图候选，并将其转换为有序的 SVG 笔画；附录 A.2 描述了图像处理、骨架化和笔画排序的步骤。 我们使用末端执行器位姿控制器在 ManiSkill [ 30 ] 中回放每条 SVG，并在不相连的笔画之间抬笔。 我们记录 RGB 观测、机器人本体感知和动作作为观测-动作对，然后将轨迹转换为机器人数据集格式。 尽管我们的主要实验使用基于 SAPIEN 后端的 ManiSkill，我们也如图 4 所示在 MuJoCo 和 Isaac Sim 中实现了该流程。

paragraphs.en: To collect representative and diverse drawing trajectories, we adopt the setting from the Google Quick, Draw! [ 10 ] dataset, which contains 345 object classes and millions of human-drawn sketches. We select 132 classes that are commonly found in the real world and can be easily drawn by a robot arm. We further define 150 compositional classes by pairing two of the 100 base classes with spatial relations. Among them, 100 classes use left-right relations, while the remaining 50 use vertical relations such as “over” and “under”. For each class, we generate 100 trajectories using the pipeline described above, resulting in 15,000 compositional trajectories and 28,200 trajectories in total.
paragraphs.zh: 为了收集具有代表性和多样性的绘图轨迹，我们采用了 Google Quick, Draw! 的设置。 [ 10 ] 数据集，其中包含 345 个物体类别和数百万条由人类绘制的素描。 我们选取了 132 个现实世界中常见且机械臂易于绘制的类别。 我们进一步通过将 100 个基础类别中的两个与空间关系配对，定义了 150 个组合类别。 其中 100 个类别使用左右关系，其余 50 个类别使用诸如“上方”和“下方”等垂直关系。 对于每个类别，我们使用上述流程生成 100 条轨迹，最终得到 15,000 条组合轨迹，总计 28,200 条轨迹。

paragraphs.en: To quantitatively characterize the advantage of BURGER in providing multimodal trajectory data, we compare its instruction-conditioned trajectory diversity with LIBERO, as visualized in Figure 2 . Since BURGER focuses on drawing rather than full-space manipulation, we cluster planar end-effector trajectories on the drawing plane with a shared codebook and estimate the effective number of modes from the cluster frequencies. We use k = 24 k=24 for the reported results and observe consistently higher multimodality for BURGER across different choices of k k . Under this setting, LIBERO contains 1.09 1.09 effective modes per instruction on average, compared with 7.13 7.13 for BURGER, corresponding to a 6.6 × 6.6\times increase. The same trajectory representation and clustering procedure is also used to analyze policy rollouts in Sec. 4.3 , and more details are provided in Appendix A.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了定量刻画BURGER在提供多模态轨迹数据方面的优势，我们将其指令条件下的轨迹多样性与LIBERO进行比较，如图2所示。 由于BURGER专注于绘图而非全空间操作，我们在绘图平面上使用共享码本对平面末端执行器轨迹进行聚类，并根据聚类频率估计有效模式数量。 我们在报告的结果中使用k=24，并观察到BURGER在不同k值选择下始终表现出更高的多模态性。 在此设置下，LIBERO每条指令平均包含1.09个有效模式，而BURGER为7.13个，相当于6.6倍的增长。 同样的轨迹表示和聚类程序也用于分析4.3节中的策略回放，更多细节见附录A.4。

paragraphs.en: We also collect real-robot trajectories to evaluate whether the BURGER data pipeline can support real-world policy learning. The real-robot dataset follows the same data format as the simulated dataset and includes two RealSense camera views from the front and back of the workspace; either view can be used as the visual observation input. Figure 3 shows the hardware setup and real-robot data-collection process. The same pipeline supports both single-object and compositional drawing tasks, as illustrated by the “birthday cake” and “moon left of sailboat” examples. In this work, we collect 10 single-object classes with 10 demonstrations per class for real-robot training and evaluation.

paragraphs.en: Valid drawings can differ in geometry and stroke order, making drawing quality difficult to evaluate with image-text similarity alone. paragraphs.en: To obtain a more human-aligned and fine-grained evaluation metric, we design a contrastive feature-based evaluator trained directly on the BURGER drawing distribution. Our evaluator builds a sketch-specific metric space on top of a frozen DINOv3 backbone [ 28 ] , which allows us to score each drawing by its similarity to the target-class prototype. For compositional tasks, we separate the two objects at the minimum-connectivity boundary and evaluate their identities and spatial relation. Appendix B.2 provides the metric architecture, training objectives, and scoring procedure. In a user study covering 10 classes, our metric agrees more closely with human judgments than CLIPScore across Spearman correlation, Kendall’s τ b \tau_{b} , and pairwise agreement. Details are also provided in Appendix B.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了获得更符合人类判断且更细粒度的评估指标，我们设计了一个基于对比特征的评估器，直接在 BURGER 绘画分布上训练。 我们的评估器在冻结的 DINOv3 主干 [ 28 ] 之上构建了一个针对简笔画-specific 的度量空间，使我们能够根据每幅绘画与目标类别原型的相似度为其打分。 对于组合性任务，我们在最小连通边界处分离两个物体，并评估它们的身份及其空间关系。 附录 B.2 提供了该指标的结构、训练目标和打分流程。 在一项覆盖 10 个类别的用户研究中，我们的指标在 Spearman 相关系数、Kendall's τ b \tau_{b} 以及成对一致性方面都比 CLIPScore 更接近人类判断。 更多细节也提供在附录 B.2 中。

paragraphs.en: Our experiments evaluate the capabilities and limitations of VLA models on language-conditioned robotic drawing tasks in BURGER. Concretely, we investigate three questions: (1) whether BURGER can serve as a diagnostic benchmark for comparing VLA models across several dimensions, including data scaling, language grounding, spatial-relation understanding, and multimodal behavior modeling; (2) whether the benchmark can expose characteristic failure behaviors and help diagnose differences among VLA formulations; and (3) whether policies trained with BURGER data can transfer to real-world drawing and support closed-loop interaction under human modifications.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实验评估了 VLA 模型在 BURGER 中语言条件化机器人绘图任务上的能力与局限。 具体而言，我们研究了三个问题：（1）BURGER 能否作为一个诊断性基准，用于从多个维度比较 VLA 模型，包括数据扩展、语言接地、空间关系理解以及多模态行为建模；（2）该基准能否揭示特征性的失败行为，并帮助诊断不同 VLA 构建方式之间的差异；（3）使用 BURGER 数据训练的策略能否迁移到真实世界的绘图任务中，并支持在人为修改下的闭环交互。

paragraphs.en: We diagnose language grounding and semantic generalization across the π \pi -family models along two dimensions. First, we evaluate language-conditioned instruction following by varying the object names in the prompts. Starting from the same blank canvas, different language instructions lead the policies to generate different objects corresponding to the requested categories. Across the in-distribution tasks, we observe no evident confusion between objects. In contrast, when the instruction specifies an out-of-distribution object category, the models fail to generate the corresponding object. This suggests that the learned language grounding is effective for the trained semantic categories but does not directly generalize to unseen object concepts.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从两个维度对 π \pi 系列模型的语言接地与语义泛化能力进行诊断。 首先，我们通过改变提示词中的物体名称来评估基于语言条件的指令跟随能力。 从同一空白画布出发，不同的语言指令会使策略生成与所请求类别相对应的不同物体。 在分布内任务中，我们没有观察到物体之间出现明显的混淆。 相比之下，当指令指定一个分布外的物体类别时，模型无法生成相应的物体。 这表明学到的语言接地对已训练的语义类别是有效的，但并不能直接泛化到未见过的物体概念上。

paragraphs.en: Second, we evaluate spatial understanding using compositional drawing tasks with prompts of the form “draw A on the left of B”, “draw A under B”, and “draw A over B”. Our goal is to study whether VLA models can generalize simple spatial relations beyond memorized object compositions. For this evaluation, policies are trained on these compositional tasks. As shown in the right-most column in Figure 5 , VLA models can generate valid left-right and over-under object compositions even for object pairs that are not observed during training. For example, a policy can draw a cup to the left of an apple despite never being trained on this specific composition. We also observe that the policies correctly distinguish different spatial instructions. These results suggest that the policies can generalize beyond memorized object compositions and apply learned spatial relations to unseen object pairs.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，我们使用组合式绘图任务来评估空间理解能力，其提示形式为“在B的左边画A”、“在B下面画A”和“在B上面画A”。 我们的目标是研究VLA模型能否将简单的空间关系泛化到记忆之外的对象组合上。 在此评估中，策略在这些组合任务上进行训练。 如图5最右侧一列所示，即使对于训练中未出现过的对象对，VLA模型也能生成有效的左右组合和上下组合。 例如，策略可以在苹果的左边画一个杯子，尽管从未在这一特定组合上训练过。 我们还观察到，策略能够正确区分不同的空间指令。 这些结果表明，策略能够泛化到记忆的对象组合之外，并将学到的空间关系应用于未见过的对象对。

paragraphs.en: We present BURGER, a language-conditioned robotic drawing benchmark that supports scalable generation of diverse robot trajectories and fine-grained evaluation of semantic grounding, spatial reasoning, multimodal behavior modeling, and action generation. Our experiments reveal how representative VLA models respond to increasing data scale and task diversity, while exposing distinct failure patterns beyond binary task success. Real-robot experiments further demonstrate drawing with visual feedback, including responses to human-added strokes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 BURGER，一个语言条件化机器人绘画基准，支持可扩展地生成多样化机器人轨迹，并对语义接地、空间推理、多模态行为建模和动作生成进行细粒度评估。 我们的实验揭示了代表性 VLA 模型如何应对不断增长的数据规模和任务多样性，同时暴露出超越二元任务成功之外的独特失败模式。 真实机器人实验进一步展示了带有视觉反馈的绘画，包括对人工添加笔画的响应。

paragraphs.en: Although BURGER provides a scalable and diagnostic testbed for evaluating language-conditioned robotic drawing, several limitations remain in our benchmark. First, our setup abstracts away many physical complexities of painting. Unlike robotic painting systems that model brush dynamics [ 34 , 27 ] , BURGER focuses on sketch-level stroke generation with a drawing tool. This simplification makes the benchmark scalable, but limits its coverage of contact-rich artistic media such as brush painting. Second, the dataset may inherit biases from the automatic generation pipeline. Our stroke-order heuristics may introduce drawing styles that differ from human demonstrations. As a result, the dataset may not fully represent natural human drawing behaviors.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 BURGER 为评估语言条件下的机器人绘画提供了一个可扩展且具备诊断性的测试平台，但我们的基准测试仍存在若干局限性。 首先，我们的设置抽象掉了绘画中许多物理上的复杂性。 与对笔刷动力学建模的机器人绘画系统 [34, 27] 不同，BURGER 专注于使用绘图工具进行素描级别的笔画生成。 这种简化使得基准测试具备可扩展性，但也限制了其对毛笔绘画等接触密集型艺术媒介的覆盖。 其次，该数据集可能继承来自自动生成流程的偏差。 我们的笔画顺序启发式方法可能引入与人类示范不同的绘画风格。 因此，该数据集可能无法完全代表自然的人类绘画行为。

paragraphs.en: Prompt sent to the image generator: Create one image containing exactly 16 ultra-simple black line-art <object> icons arranged in a clean 4 4 by 4 4 grid. Each cell contains one centered icon with generous white space. All icons must be recognizable as the same object category, and their basic outer shape should remain mostly consistent. Every icon should still look slightly different through small pose, size, angle, or detail changes. Important view constraint: regardless of pose or angle, the object’s front/main recognizable face must be mostly visible. Avoid rear views, back views, extreme side views, hidden fronts, heavy occlusion, or cropped-off main faces. Make diversity come from combining several simple differences, without adding line complexity. Use clear size variation across the grid, but keep every icon isolated and easy to cut out. For animals, combine pose, slight front-facing angle, head direction, tail/ear shape, and body proportion changes. For objects and still lifes, combine front-facing orientation, silhouette, placement, proportion, and one tiny detail change. Use these variation types: small silhouette differences, slightly different sizes, small pose or action changes for animals, small orientation or placement changes for objects and still lifes, slight viewing angle changes, and one tiny contour/detail change. Avoid repeating the same design twice. Do not create very different object types, complex shapes, dense internal lines, realistic texture, horizontal compositions, extreme tall shapes, extreme wide shapes, and extra props. Hard line-count constraint: each icon should be composed of only 5 or 6 total simple strokes/lines whenever possible. Use only the outer contour plus at most 1 or 2 tiny internal detail lines. Avoid many details, many small marks, texture, shading, filling, decorations, dense internal lines, or line-heavy patterns. Each icon should be a clean minimal outline, easy to cut out, with a compact simple shape. Black lines only, white background, no color, no shading, no filled areas except tiny solid black dots used only for animal eyes as specified below, no text, no watermark, no extra objects. Each icon should fit comfortably inside an imaginary square cell with similar margins on all sides. Category-specific rules: For animals, always draw the full whole body in each cell—never head-only, face crop, or partial-body views; every animal must have clearly visible eyes (never omit eyes).
paragraphs.zh: 发送给图像生成器的提示词：生成一张图片，其中恰好包含 16 个超简单的黑色线条 <object> 图标，以整洁的 4 4 乘 4 4 网格排列。 每个单元格包含一个居中的图标，并留有充足的留白。 所有图标必须能被识别为同一物体类别，且它们的基本外形应基本保持一致。 每个图标仍应通过姿势、大小、角度或细节的微小变化呈现出略微不同的样子。 重要的视角限制：无论姿势或角度如何，物体的正面/主要可识别面必须大部分可见。 避免背面视角、后视、极端侧视、正面被遮挡、严重遮挡或主要面被裁切的情况。 让多样性来自几种简单差异的组合，而不增加线条复杂度。 在网格中使用明显的大小变化，但保持每个图标相互独立且易于裁剪。 对于动物，组合姿势、略微朝前的角度、头部朝向、尾巴/耳朵形状以及身体比例的变化。 对于物体和静物，组合朝前的朝向、轮廓、摆放位置、比例以及一个微小的细节变化。 使用以下变化类型：微小的轮廓差异、略微不同的大小、动物的微小姿势或动作变化、物体和静物的微小朝向或摆放位置变化、轻微的视角变化，以及一个微小的轮廓/细节变化。 避免重复相同的设计两次。 不要创建差异很大的物体类型、复杂形状、密集的内部线条、写实纹理、横向构图、极端细长的形状、极端宽扁的形状以及额外的道具。 硬性线条数限制：尽可能让每个图标仅由总共 5 或 6 条简单笔画/线条构成。 仅使用外轮廓加上至多 1 或 2 条微小的内部细节线条。 避免过多细节、许多小标记、纹理、阴影、填充、装饰、密集的内部线条或线条繁密的图案。 每个图标应是干净的最简轮廓，易于裁剪，形状紧凑简洁。 仅使用黑色线条、白色背景、无颜色、无阴影、无填充区域（下文规定的仅用于动物眼睛的微小实心黑点除外）、无文字、无水印、无额外物体。 每个图标应舒适地置于一个假想的方形单元格内，且四周留白相近。 类别特定规则：对于动物，每个单元格中始终绘制完整的全身——绝不只画头部、裁切面部或局部身体视角；每只动物必须有清晰可见的眼睛（绝不省略眼睛）。

sents.en: Prompt sent to the image generator: Create one image containing exactly 16 ultra-simple black line-art <object> icons arranged in a clean 4 4 by 4 4 grid.
sents.zh: 发送给图像生成器的提示词：生成一张图片，其中恰好包含 16 个超简单的黑色线条 <object> 图标，以整洁的 4 4 乘 4 4 网格排列。

sents.en: Each cell contains one centered icon with generous white space.
sents.zh: 每个单元格包含一个居中的图标，并留有充足的留白。

sents.en: All icons must be recognizable as the same object category, and their basic outer shape should remain mostly consistent.
sents.zh: 所有图标必须能被识别为同一物体类别，且它们的基本外形应基本保持一致。

sents.en: Every icon should still look slightly different through small pose, size, angle, or detail changes.
sents.zh: 每个图标仍应通过姿势、大小、角度或细节的微小变化呈现出略微不同的样子。

sents.en: Important view constraint: regardless of pose or angle, the object’s front/main recognizable face must be mostly visible.
sents.zh: 重要的视角限制：无论姿势或角度如何，物体的正面/主要可识别面必须大部分可见。

sents.en: Avoid rear views, back views, extreme side views, hidden fronts, heavy occlusion, or cropped-off main faces.
sents.zh: 避免背面视角、后视、极端侧视、正面被遮挡、严重遮挡或主要面被裁切的情况。

sents.en: Make diversity come from combining several simple differences, without adding line complexity.
sents.zh: 让多样性来自几种简单差异的组合，而不增加线条复杂度。

sents.en: Use clear size variation across the grid, but keep every icon isolated and easy to cut out.
sents.zh: 在网格中使用明显的大小变化，但保持每个图标相互独立且易于裁剪。

sents.en: For animals, combine pose, slight front-facing angle, head direction, tail/ear shape, and body proportion changes.
sents.zh: 对于动物，组合姿势、略微朝前的角度、头部朝向、尾巴/耳朵形状以及身体比例的变化。

sents.en: For objects and still lifes, combine front-facing orientation, silhouette, placement, proportion, and one tiny detail change.
sents.zh: 对于物体和静物，组合朝前的朝向、轮廓、摆放位置、比例以及一个微小的细节变化。

sents.en: Use these variation types: small silhouette differences, slightly different sizes, small pose or action changes for animals, small orientation or placement changes for objects and still lifes, slight viewing angle changes, and one tiny contour/detail change.
sents.zh: 使用以下变化类型：微小的轮廓差异、略微不同的大小、动物的微小姿势或动作变化、物体和静物的微小朝向或摆放位置变化、轻微的视角变化，以及一个微小的轮廓/细节变化。

sents.en: Avoid repeating the same design twice.
sents.zh: 避免重复相同的设计两次。

sents.en: Do not create very different object types, complex shapes, dense internal lines, realistic texture, horizontal compositions, extreme tall shapes, extreme wide shapes, and extra props.
sents.zh: 不要创建差异很大的物体类型、复杂形状、密集的内部线条、写实纹理、横向构图、极端细长的形状、极端宽扁的形状以及额外的道具。

sents.en: Hard line-count constraint: each icon should be composed of only 5 or 6 total simple strokes/lines whenever possible.
sents.zh: 硬性线条数限制：尽可能让每个图标仅由总共 5 或 6 条简单笔画/线条构成。

sents.en: Use only the outer contour plus at most 1 or 2 tiny internal detail lines.
sents.zh: 仅使用外轮廓加上至多 1 或 2 条微小的内部细节线条。

sents.en: Avoid many details, many small marks, texture, shading, filling, decorations, dense internal lines, or line-heavy patterns.
sents.zh: 避免过多细节、许多小标记、纹理、阴影、填充、装饰、密集的内部线条或线条繁密的图案。

sents.en: Each icon should be a clean minimal outline, easy to cut out, with a compact simple shape.
sents.zh: 每个图标应是干净的最简轮廓，易于裁剪，形状紧凑简洁。

sents.en: Black lines only, white background, no color, no shading, no filled areas except tiny solid black dots used only for animal eyes as specified below, no text, no watermark, no extra objects.
sents.zh: 仅使用黑色线条、白色背景、无颜色、无阴影、无填充区域（下文规定的仅用于动物眼睛的微小实心黑点除外）、无文字、无水印、无额外物体。

sents.en: Each icon should fit comfortably inside an imaginary square cell with similar margins on all sides.
sents.zh: 每个图标应舒适地置于一个假想的方形单元格内，且四周留白相近。

sents.en: Category-specific rules: For animals, always draw the full whole body in each cell—never head-only, face crop, or partial-body views; every animal must have clearly visible eyes (never omit eyes).
sents.zh: 类别特定规则：对于动物，每个单元格中始终绘制完整的全身——绝不只画头部、裁切面部或局部身体视角；每只动物必须有清晰可见的眼睛（绝不省略眼睛）。

paragraphs.en: For food, never show bites or eaten/missing chunks; do not draw plates, bowls, or other dishware; if the food has cream, frosting, or similar topping, keep the same topping type and overall shape across every icon (only its scale or amount may vary slightly). For furniture, clothing, or animals, every icon must stay the same specific type within that category (one furniture piece kind, one garment kind, or one animal kind—do not mix different types). For animals whose eyes would normally be a large solid black patch or filled black area, render each eye as a single small black dot instead. For simple symbolic or single-form subjects with only one natural type (for example diamond, envelope, eye, star, or heart), keep that exact same shape and meaning in every cell—do not invent alternate variants— and create variety only through slight rotation, tilt, mirroring, or small in-plane skew. Output: one PNG image containing a 4 × 4 4\times 4 grid of minimal sketch icons.

paragraphs.en: Skeleton to SVG. Algorithm 2 summarizes the procedure of skeleton-to-SVG conversion. We first decompose the skeleton into ordered stroke paths and then convert each path into SVG commands. The resulting SVG representation preserves the stroke structure and ordering, and is subsequently replayed in the robot drawing environment to generate observation–action trajectories.

paragraphs.en: In addition, Figure 15 shows examples from our real-robot dataset, illustrating the correspondence between simulated trajectories and physical robot executions. To collect real-robot data, we replay the SVG trajectories generated by the pipeline described in Section A.2 . This data-collection process follows a planned trajectory and therefore does not require closed-loop visual feedback from the cameras. This open-loop replay procedure makes the real-robot dataset easy to construct: once SVG trajectories are available, additional demonstrations can be collected by directly replaying them on the robot without manual teleoperation or closed-loop policy execution. As shown in Figure 15 , the robot can execute representative drawing tasks, such as birthday cake , on the physical canvas. Each sample includes a language instruction, canvas observations from the front and rear cameras, the robot proprioceptive state, and the corresponding expert end-effector action. Either camera view can be used as the visual observation input.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，图 15 展示了来自我们真实机器人数据集的示例，说明了仿真轨迹与物理机器人执行之间的对应关系。 为采集真实机器人数据，我们重放由 A.2 节所述流程生成的 SVG 轨迹。 这一数据采集过程遵循预先规划的轨迹，因此不需要来自相机的闭环视觉反馈。 这种开环重放流程使得真实机器人数据集易于构建：一旦 SVG 轨迹可用，就可以通过直接在机器人上重放它们来收集额外的演示，无需人工遥操作或闭环策略执行。 如图 15 所示，机器人可以在物理画布上执行具有代表性的绘图任务，例如生日蛋糕。 每个样本包含一条语言指令、来自前后两个相机的画布观测、机器人本体感知状态，以及相应的专家末端执行器动作。 任一相机视角都可用作视觉观测输入。

paragraphs.en: In Figure 13 , we compare our generated sketches with representative sketch-generation methods and datasets, including Sketch One Part at a Time [ 8 ] , SketchAgent [ 31 ] , Gemini 3.1 Pro [ 9 ] , SDXL [ 25 ] +SwiftSketch [ 1 ] , and Google Quick, Draw! [ 10 ] . Compared with these alternatives, our generated sketches provide a favorable balance between visual recognizability and stroke simplicity: they contain a moderate number of lines, smooth contours, and clear object structure. These properties make them well suited for downstream conversion into robot-executable drawing trajectories. Moreover, because our pipeline is prompt-driven, it can scalably generate diverse sketch data conditioned on different object categories and language instructions.

[10]。 与这些替代方案相比，我们生成的素描在视觉可识别性与笔画简洁性之间取得了良好的平衡：它们包含适中的线条数量、平滑的轮廓以及清晰的对象结构。 这些特性使其非常适合下游转换为机器人可执行的绘画轨迹。 此外，由于我们的流程由提示驱动，它可以基于不同对象类别和语言指令可扩展地生成多样化的素描数据。

paragraphs.en: Our dataset is stored in the LeRobot format [ 5 ] . paragraphs.en: During evaluation, the policy receives the language prompt, the current canvas observation, and the robot proprioceptive state, and predicts an end-effector command or action chunk. An episode terminates when the robot end-effector is lifted above a predefined height threshold; therefore, the policy must learn both the drawing behavior and the appropriate termination behavior. We use the same initial-state distribution and maximum episode length across models to ensure a fair comparison. For single-object evaluation, we use 10 object classes: alarm clock, apple, backpack, banana, bathtub, bench, bicycle, birthday cake, blueberry, and book. For compositional evaluation, we test on unseen spatial compositions. For each task, we run 10 evaluation episodes and report the average score computed by our evaluation metric. The final canvas is used for visual evaluation, while the full trajectory is used for analyzing failure modes and real-robot transfer.
paragraphs.zh: 在评估过程中，策略接收语言提示、当前画布观测以及机器人本体感知状态，并预测末端执行器命令或动作块。 当机器人末端执行器被抬升到预定义的高度阈值以上时，一回合结束；因此，策略必须同时学习绘图行为和合适的终止行为。 我们在所有模型中使用相同的初始状态分布和最大回合长度，以确保公平比较。 对于单物体评估，我们使用 10 个物体类别：闹钟、苹果、背包、香蕉、浴缸、长椅、自行车、生日蛋糕、蓝莓和书本。 对于组合式评估，我们在未见过的空间组合上进行测试。 对于每个任务，我们运行 10 个评估回合，并报告由我们的评估指标计算得到的平均分数。 最终画布用于视觉评估，而完整轨迹用于分析失败模式和真机迁移。

sents.en: For compositional tasks, we first split the foreground strokes into object regions using a vertical or horizontal separator with the lowest foreground-pixel density, evaluate each region against its corresponding object class center, and average the two similarities.
sents.zh: 对于组合任务，我们首先使用前景像素密度最低的垂直或水平分隔线将前景笔画切分为目标区域，将每个区域与其对应的目标类中心进行评估，并对两个相似度取平均。

sents.en: We further penalize predictions whose detected ordering does not match the prompted spatial relation.
sents.zh: 我们进一步对检测结果中的顺序与所提示的空间关系不匹配的预测施加惩罚。

paragraphs.en: Correlation with Human Judgments. We conduct a user study on 10 single-object classes to evaluate whether our latent-based similarity metric is aligned with human judgments. For each class, 66 participants are shown five drawings: four model-generated drawings produced by two VLA models and one ground-truth drawing from our dataset. Participants are asked to rank the five drawings from best to worst according to how well each drawing depicts the prompted object class. We then evaluate the same drawings using our DINOv3-based [ 28 ] similarity metric and CLIPScore [ 11 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 与人类判断的相关性。 我们对10个单物体类别进行了用户研究，以评估我们基于潜变量的相似度度量是否与人类判断一致。 对于每个类别，66名参与者会看到五幅图：四幅由两个VLA模型生成的图，以及一幅来自我们数据集的真值图。 参与者需要根据每幅图对所提示物体类别的描绘程度，将五幅图从最好到最差进行排序。 然后，我们使用基于DINOv3的[ 28 ]相似度度量和CLIPScore [ 11 ]评估同样的图。

paragraphs.en: To quantify alignment with human judgments, we compute three complementary measures. First, we use Spearman’s rank correlation coefficient and Kendall τ b \tau_{b} correlation coefficient to compare the aggregate human ranking with rankings induced by each metric. For each drawing, the aggregate human score is computed as the negative mean human rank, so that larger values correspond to better human preference. Kendall’s τ b \tau_{b} is used because it accounts for tied ranks, which occur frequently for CLIPScore due to score saturation. Second, we compute pairwise agreement by comparing each participant’s preference over every within-class pair of drawings with the corresponding pairwise preference induced by the metric. Thus, Spearman’s ρ \rho and Kendall’s τ b \tau_{b} evaluate agreement with the aggregate human ranking, while pairwise agreement measures consistency with individual human judgments.
paragraphs.zh: 为了量化与人类判断的一致性，我们计算了三种互补的度量。 首先，我们使用 Spearman 等级相关系数和 Kendall τ b \tau_{b} 相关系数，将汇总的人类排名与每种度量所诱导的排名进行比较。 对于每幅绘画，汇总的人类得分计算为人类排名均值的负值，因此数值越大表示人类偏好越好。 使用 Kendall 的 τ b \tau_{b} 是因为它考虑了并列排名，而 CLIPScore 由于分数饱和经常出现并列排名。 其次，我们通过将每位参与者对每对同类绘画的偏好与该度量所诱导的相应成对偏好进行比较，来计算成对一致性。 因此，Spearman 的 ρ \rho 和 Kendall 的 τ b \tau_{b} 评估的是与汇总人类排名的一致性，而成对一致性衡量的是与个体人类判断的一致性。

paragraphs.en: Inference. For real-robot inference, we first align the real camera observations with the simulated canvas coordinate system. Our setup uses two Intel RealSense cameras, placed at the front and back of the workspace, to reduce occlusion caused by the robot arm. To extract the drawing strokes on the canvas, we use depth observations to segment out the robot arm and then estimate the visible stroke regions from each camera view. The stroke observations from the two views are merged and provided as visual input to the trained VLA policy. The policy outputs target TCP positions, which are executed by the Franka Panda robot arm.
paragraphs.zh: 推理。 对于真实机器人推理，我们首先将真实相机观测与仿真画布坐标系对齐。 我们的设置使用两个 Intel RealSense 相机，分别放置在工作区的前方和后方，以减少机械臂造成的遮挡。 为了提取画布上的绘制笔画，我们使用深度观测分割出机械臂，然后从每个相机视角估计可见的笔画区域。 来自两个视角的笔画观测被合并后，作为视觉输入提供给训练好的 VLA 策略。 该策略输出目标 TCP 位置，由 Franka Panda 机械臂执行。

paragraphs.en: Human–Robot Interaction. Our perception pipeline also supports human–robot collaborative drawing. During execution, depth observations are used to detect when a human hand enters the canvas region. When a hand is detected, policy inference is temporarily paused while the user modifies the drawing, either by adding new strokes or erasing existing ones. After the user leaves the workspace, the updated canvas is captured and processed using the same stroke-extraction and multi-view merging pipeline described above. The resulting canvas representation is then provided to the VLA policy as a new observation, and the robot resumes drawing conditioned on the updated canvas state. This procedure enables iterative collaboration between a human user and the robot within a shared drawing workspace.
paragraphs.zh: 人–机器人交互。 我们的感知流程还支持人–机器人协作绘画。 在执行过程中，深度观测被用于检测人手何时进入画布区域。 当检测到手时，策略推理会暂时暂停，用户可以修改绘画，例如添加新的笔画或擦除已有的笔画。 在用户离开工作区后，系统会捕获更新后的画布，并使用上文所述的相同的笔画提取与多视角合并流程进行处理。 所得到的画布表示随后作为新的观测提供给 VLA 策略，机器人基于更新后的画布状态继续绘画。 该流程使人类用户与机器人能够在共享的绘画工作区内进行迭代式协作。
